background: Lloyds Bank plc is the main ring-fenced bank of Lloyds Banking Group, the UK's largest retail bank, funded by UK personal and business deposits and lending mainly on residential mortgages, cards, motor finance and to UK companies.
synthesis: Ratings are AA from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A+ from S&P and A1 from Moody's, all stable. Capital is mixed against UK majors: CET1 of 13.6% is just under the peer median, while leverage of 5.1% is in the top quarter against 4.9%. Liquidity is the weak side, with LCR of 134% and NSFR of 118% both in the bottom quarter, against the peer medians. Leverage has fallen 0.3 points since 30 Jun 2025 and the rest has been flat. The flagged news is the Arena Television fraud claims reported on 9 Aug 2026 and 10 Aug 2026, a legal exposure rather than a balance-sheet event.
